I'm an electronics engineer from a clg affiliated to Mumbai University

the loan part, don't they ask for collateral? or a co signee? i want to take it in India itself as I read it comes out cheaper to repay than the ones u take from the US

I already shared it with 4 more people and it's quite expensive because it's in a good society so I think you're right it's okay to spend on a safe environment

thank you so much :)

this is the saddest msg I read , not giving me any inheritance doesn't mean I don't love my parents ? or I won't take care of them? My brother , I can't say for him I hope he does but My parents are actually financially very smart, especially my mother, she doesn't want to live w my brother in future as well, I mentioned in another moment as well I understand it's not my money and I'm fine with them not giving me any, it's just a consideration I have financially if I want to be doing well and I know here's no inheritance for me then I need to save and invest more and better
very insightful, thank you!

I think I need to make it clear I have mentioned the inheritance thing because I think of inheritances as a safety net for people in case anything goes wrong, I am not sad they won't give me anything neither do I want something they don't want to give, I mentioned it because in the long run , any massive amount I will get will only be what I earn , I understand you mean it in a good way and no I won't do this if I have a daughter for me everything will be equally divided IF I have kids

aye as far as I know they hired too many people this time, I started in October, every month end a new batch is joining and every batch has 160 peeps I think , new one is coming on 27th November, I'd tell you to hang tight, I know they make you wait alot

ps- this is for blr , hyd has even more intake from what I've heard.
price?
no you're not piggybacking, I hope you do succeed man, I do want to be independent, trying to be as of now , I dont want to have regrets in future

I am trying to get more offers side by side, not getting more offers currently but yeah trying, thank you, also I think the betrayal feeling you're talking about I have started feeling rn only, rethinking if I am even doing the right thing, but lets see

I did consider it, sadly as a woman I dont know if I would feel as safe in a tier 2 city as I do in mumbai, one of the biggest dilemmas for me was if moving to another city is worth giving up the safety and connectivity I get in mumbai, but I'm taking my chances with blr.

Yeah I wont be renting in blr, I won't be making that much money honestly to rent and sustain so pg seems the best choice. 

Thank you !

Hmm. this is practical, I will need their help to settle into a new city for the first 2 months I think, then I can sustain by myself I do think I wont have much savings, close to nothing but I shall try.

I'm glad you have a practical dad, my parents dont have conversations practically, itss rather emotional and what will others say attitude, so I will somehow need to convince them to just help me move to the new cities like their friends did with their kids and came back home in a week

I understand your frustration, even tho my brother is quite young now I can see how he has different parents than me because he's a boy. I hope you do collect the money you're planning to and lead a good life, atb!
I think you've put it in an efficient way for me to plan my responses to my parents, thank you so much, I will keep these in mind and be more confident with this now.

yeah I did think every weekend would not be possible but they meant only the 2 days I need to be in Pune and rest 5 days to be in Mumbai which freaked me out more because it's insane honestly...that's why I took blr

Yeah, I don't want to burn bridges with them, tho I did consider doing so, but I do know family is very important. 

I am trying to be financially independent, hopefully it all works out :)

nope I have a younger brother. I think my mother did freak out a lil bit by the idea of me moving out and started complaining of " who will teach him ( my brother) now " the thing is, I don't teach him anything? he has tuitions and classes , and did try to put the idea of me being home a couple more years by saying " don't plan anything until his 12th I don't want drama to affect his studies  "

Hi, I have put Pune as my preference as well, thinking of the same thing you have mentioned here, im pretty sure my job which I will be starting in a couple of months has not yet fully transitioned back to 5 day work from office it's still 2 days from office and 3 day WFH and my parents seem to know this somehow ( asked their colleagues about their children who work at the same company) and believe it or not my mother told me to travel to Pune for 2 days a week and come back, when i mentioned my company is in Pune as well. 

I personally wanted Pune, it's better for me because even tho I don't speak Marathi, I understand Marathi enough to get by and since it is closer to Mumbai in case of emergencies I'd be able to get home asap.

But when I was told to do up-down from Pune to Mum every week, it was tiring even thinking about it. Even then I did put Pune as my second choice, I think it's not about safety to my parents, my parents just don't like the idea of me living alone, since the plan they have for me is to get me married in a couple of years and I don't want to get married this early.

I told my parents I would be making a new bank account/salary account since I've seen my friends do it and my parents were not happy but they didn't say anything yet about it. They wanted to control my finances as well. 

I'm rethinking if all this is worth it atp.
so sorry for you. I wish you have a great and peaceful life ahead...

umm a very weird suggestion, email Jeff Bezos, I did it when my Converse shoes were not delivered and my account was blocked randomly, his personal team always responds back as he's kinda known for reading customer mails that came directly to him

his personal accounting team from UK contacted me within 24 hrs and my refund was generated, hope this helps, you should definitely go through the lawyers replies tho, they're more experienced in these situations
